newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Kalgold output disappoints, plans cash call.
newsitem.headline: Kalgold output disappoints, plans cash call.

text.p: Kalahari Goldridge Mining Co Ltd, which made its debut on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange last month, warned on Monday that gold production would be lower than expected in the year to December 31, 1996.
The company said mining tonnages and grades in the open pit were in line with original forecasts.

"However, owing to post-commissioning problems which relate to the integration of the various components of the processing plant, progress to date has been slower than anticipated. This will result in gold production being lower than forecast for the period to December 31, 1996," it said.
Steps were being taken to address the problems, Kalgold said.
The company said it planned to issue shares for cash as contemplated at the time of the listing. Authority for the move will be sought at an extraordianry general meeting on December 3.
Banking sources had said last month said the firm was likely to issue for cash up to 9.5 million new shares at some time within the next six months.
